high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the user "sydney_sweeney." The post was made 15 minutes prior to the screenshot being taken, as indicated by the timestamp at the top of the screen. The post is marked as a paid partnership with "drinkbai," as shown by the checkmark and the text "Paid partnership with drinkbai" next to the username. The main content of the post features numerous small, woven baskets filled with fresh raspberries. The baskets appear to be made of light-colored wood or bamboo and have handles tied with green string.
